name: Modal
purpose: A centered overlay that interrupts the page for a focused task or decision — blocks interaction with the rest of the page until dismissed.
neverUseFor: Non-blocking supplementary info — use Tooltip or Popover instead
A persistent side task alongside the main content — use SidePanel instead
Simple confirmations that don't need to block the whole page — consider inline UI first
rationale: Modal relies on native HTML <dialog> and showModal() (ADR-010) to guarantee focus trapping, Escape key handling, and top-layer browser stacking without custom z-index hacks.

mayExtendLocally: Custom body content composition with forms or step flows
mustEscalateToDS: Overriding focus-trap or backdrop z-index mechanics
Replacing native <dialog> with custom absolute divs

authored.name: expanded
authored.description: Whether the modal is open. See ADR-010 for the open/close choreography (native `<dialog>` + `showModal()`, JS-timed close).

anatomy.description: Native <dialog>, opened via showModal() — provides the backdrop, focus trap, Escape-to-close, and top-layer stacking for free (ADR-010). Centered, min-height 400px.
The modal's accessible name — referenced via aria-labelledby.
An IconButton (IconX, size l) positioned top-right, calls onDismiss.
Two-slot action row (space-between) — start/end below. Rendered only when at least one action label is given.
Bottom-left slot — the tertiary action, if any.
Bottom-right slot — secondary button (if any), then primary.

props.name: label
props.description: The modal's title — rendered visibly and used as its accessible name.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the modal is open. Modal is always controlled — there's no uncontrolled/defaultExpanded form, since something outside the modal always has to trigger it open.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the modal should close — the close (X) button, Escape, or a backdrop click. Modal does not close itself; the consumer sets `expanded` to false in response.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Whether to render the header's close (X) button.

props.name: closeOnBackdropClick
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop dismisses the modal.

props.name: primaryActionLabel
props.description: Footer primary action button label. Omit (with secondaryActionLabel) to render no footer.

props.name: secondaryActionLabel
props.description: Footer secondary action button label, to the primary's left.

props.name: tertiaryActionLabel
props.description: A tertiary action button, pinned to the footer's bottom-left corner (Button's `ghost` variant), separate from the primary/secondary group.

width.note: Content-driven up to a reasonable reading width — no fixed rung, same category as Tooltip's max-width.

height.note: min-height, not a fixed height — grows for longer content. Not on the shared size scale, same category of per-component literal as SidePanel's width.

keyboardNav: Escape — dismisses (native <dialog> cancel event, redirected through onDismiss per ADR-010)
Tab — cycles focus, trapped inside the modal (native)
notes: showCloseButton=false with no footer action leaves the modal with no on-screen dismiss affordance — the component logs a dev-only console.warn in that case (Escape and closeOnBackdropClick, when enabled, still work).

focus.note: focus is drawn by Button, IconButton — see their a11y.applied.focus

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: tertiaryAction
properties.description: Ghost Button on the footer's left (rendered when the label is set).

figma.structure: The open dialog (no backdrop): 560px,  min-height 400,  radius/xl,  shadow / xl,  fill/page. The header's 72px right padding (closeInset × 2 + the 40px close button,  a calc in code) is three nested tokens: 16 (spacing/m) + 40 (spacing/250) + 16 (spacing/m). Title Heading / xl / Bold (24px,  raised from l on 2026-10-20 by the owner). Close = IconButton ghost l,  absolute 16px from the top/right. Footer: Button m instances,  4px apart. Measured identical to code.

primaryActionLabel.reason: the primary action is a nested Button instance: the BOOLEAN shows it and the exposed Button's own children property holds its text — a TEXT on the Modal can't reach a nested instance's text

secondaryActionLabel.reason: the secondary action is a nested Button instance: the BOOLEAN shows it and the exposed Button's own children property holds its text — a TEXT on the Modal can't reach a nested instance's text

tertiaryActionLabel.reason: the tertiary action is a nested Button instance: the BOOLEAN shows it and the exposed Button's own children property holds its text — a TEXT on the Modal can't reach a nested instance's text
